target.name: Agility Robotics
target.founder: Jonathan Hurst, Damion Shelton, Mikhail Jones

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Agility Robotics operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at the pre-IPO stage, having raised over $400 million to date. The valuation universe consists of one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The narrow peer set in this sector—while comprising ten same-sector companies—does not yield a sufficient comparable group meeting stage and valuation-tier filters needed for robust median-based analysis.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable here. A disciplined screen for same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with similar valuation tiers returned zero datapoints across all narrow filters, falling short of the minimum three comparables required for statistically meaningful peer analysis. Expanding the filter to all ten sector companies would introduce material heterogeneity in stage, capital efficiency, and market positioning, rendering a sector-wide median unreliable as a valuation anchor.

The lack of narrow-set comparable data constrains the analysis. A credible valuation range would require either alternative methods (precedent transactions, DCF, or revenue multiple approaches with disclosed metrics) or expansion of the peer universe to include adjacent sectors (automation, AI-enabled logistics) with sufficient stage-matched data. Without such inputs, quantitative synthesis cannot be responsibly offered. The single public comparable and five named private peers merit individual assessment, but require granular financial and operational metrics not present in this dataset to establish a defensible valuation.
